title: 3 Reasons God Sometimes Feels Silent
paragraphs:
Sometimes the hardest part of faith
is praying… and hearing nothing back.

You ask.
You wait.
You wonder if God is listening.
But silence does not mean absence.

If every prayer were answered instantly, faith would never grow.
Sometimes God allows silence so trust can deepen.

God often works behind the scenes long before we see the results.
What feels like delay may actually be preparation.
3 – God is drawing you into deeper prayer

Silence can pull us closer.
Instead of giving quick answers, God invites us into deeper relationship.

“Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.”
— Hebrews 11:1
Faith grows strongest when we trust God even when we cannot see what He is doing.
Your silence season may actually be a faith-building season.
